name: token vegetable side

recipe.title: Garlicky spinach skillet
steps:
Prepare the spinach
Rinse the spinach and mince the garlic.

Wilt the greens
Cook the garlic and spinach in a covered pan over low heat for 2–3 minutes until wilted. Divide between two plates.

reason: 100 g spinach and two garlic cloves are a side dish, not a meal for two.

name: substantial vegetarian pasta

recipe.title: Garlic tomato pasta
steps:
Boil the pasta
Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling water according to the packet instructions until al dente.

Make the sauce
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and stir in the minced garlic for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10–12 minutes until slightly thickened.

Combine and serve
Drain the pasta and toss it with the sauce. Divide between two bowls.

reason: 200 g dry pasta with a tomato sauce is a coherent meal for two without requiring a protein category.

name: unlisted fish in instructions

recipe.title: Salmon tomato pasta
steps:
Boil the pasta
Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling water according to the packet instructions until al dente.

Make the sauce
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and stir in the minced garlic for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10–12 minutes until slightly thickened.

Finish with salmon
Fold 300 g cooked salmon into the sauce before adding the drained pasta.

reason: The title and instructions add salmon absent from the ingredient list.

name: two-vegetable side

recipe.title: Roasted carrots and green beans
steps:
Roast the vegetables
Toss the carrots and green beans with the oil on a sheet pan and roast at 425°F for 20–25 minutes until browned at the edges and tender.

Serve
Divide between two plates.

reason: Two roasted vegetables are a side dish, however large the amounts.

name: garnish plate

recipe.title: Herb and lemon plate
steps:
Arrange the plate
Pick the parsley leaves, slice the scallions, and cut the lemon into wedges. Arrange them on two plates.

reason: Herbs, scallions and lemon wedges garnish a dish; they are not one.

name: snack plate when a meal was asked

recipe.title: Celery with peanut butter
steps:
Cut the celery
Trim the celery stalks and cut each into three pieces.

Fill and serve
Spread the peanut butter into the hollow of each piece and divide between two plates.

reason: Celery with peanut butter is a snack, and the cook asked for dinner.

name: real meal built from a side

recipe.title: Chickpea and carrot curry over rice
steps:
Cook the rice
Simmer the rice in a covered pot of water for 15–18 minutes until tender and the water is absorbed.

Start the curry
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat and cook the carrots for 5 minutes until they start to soften. Stir in the garlic and curry powder for 30 seconds until fragrant.

Simmer
Add the drained chickpeas and the coconut milk and simmer for 12–15 minutes until the carrots are tender and the sauce coats a spoon.

Serve
Spoon the curry over the rice in two bowls.

reason: The same chickpeas and carrots become a meal once built into a curry over rice.

name: real dessert when asked

recipe.title: Apple oat crumble
steps:
Fill the dish
Toss the sliced apples with 1 tbsp honey in an 8-inch baking dish.

Make the topping
Rub the butter into the oats with the rest of the honey until it clumps, then scatter it over the apples.

Bake
Bake at 375°F for 30–35 minutes until the topping is golden and the apples bubble at the edges.

reason: An apple oat crumble is a dessert most people recognise.
